sources.entry: DefectDojo | Vulnerability management and DevSecOps platform

summary.one_liner: DefectDojo is an open-source DevSecOps, ASPM and vulnerability management platform that aggregates security scan results, tracks findings, deduplicates them, and supports remediation and reporting.
summary.what_it_does: DefectDojo orchestrates end-to-end security testing by importing results from security scanning tools. It tracks vulnerabilities through to remediation and removes duplicate findings. It provides reporting on security posture. The README describes it as an application security posture management (ASPM) tool. Open-source use runs on local accounts; SSO (SAML, OIDC, OAuth), LDAP and MFA are listed as DefectDojo Pro features. Demo instances for both the Pro and Community editions are linked in the README, and the README suggests uploading sample scan reports to try it.
how_to_run: git clone && cd django-DefectDojo && docker compose up
docker compose logs initializer | grep "Admin password:"
docker compose up -d (detached mode; then obtain admin credentials from initializer logs)
notable: Imports results from many security testing tools and deduplicates findings
Official public demo environments for both Pro and Community editions
Community edition runs locally with Docker Compose
Maintained by named core maintainers with a community Slack
caveats: SSO, LDAP and MFA are only available in the Pro edition
Initial Docker Compose initialization can take up to 3 minutes
Public demos reset daily and must not hold sensitive data
